sections.Profile:
Phoenix , released by Williams in November 1978, is a four-player solid-state game with a fiery mythological theme, the first design by Barry Oursler, with artwork by Constantino Mitchell and Jeanine Mitchell. Completing either of its two four-bank drop-target sets raises a bonus multiplier that reaches 5x, and Williams built 6,198.
